description.value: Stickleback is a waterfront West Coast eatery perched on Cooper's Cove just outside downtown Sooke, featuring a natural cedar bar, a life-sized mural of Sombrio Beach, and a patio with wildlife and ocean views. The menu leans toward house-made burgers, wraps, pastas, Baby Back Ribs, and local halibut, with gluten-free options throughout. Situated right beside Rush Kayak Adventures, it's a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Sooke waterfront corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active, showing 2026 events and a copyright line for 2026, confirming the business is open. The website header branding reads 'Stickleback Oceanfront Cider and Taphouse' while OSM records it as 'Stickleback West Coast Eatery' — a name discrepancy that warrants flagging, though the About section still references the older name. The menu explicitly labels several items {GF} and {GF/DF}, and an 'Order Online' link confirms takeout is offered; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or most other amenities appears in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Stickleback West Coast Eatery' but the current website title and branding consistently read 'Stickleback Oceanfront Cider and Taphouse' — the business may have rebranded. OSM name retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active waterfront restaurant in Sooke with a live website, confirmed 2026 events, and a full menu — a natural stop for touring cyclists on the Sooke corridor.
